about_the_game:
King of the Hill is a 2D cartoon-style real-time strategy game. Start with a small town, recruit soldiers, expand your army, and outsmart your enemies to conquer more territories. With simple controls but deep strategy, you can enjoy the thrill of commanding massive battles with ease.

Key Features

  • Challenging Levels: Over 80 carefully designed stages, each with unique terrains and enemy formations that test your tactical skills.

  • Variety of Units: More than 20 different unit types, including infantry, archers, cavalry, and heavily armored troops – all upgradable and customizable.

  • Rune System: Unlock over 15 rune combinations that provide special bonuses and enable diverse strategic playstyles.

  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple and intuitive controls make it accessible for new players, while higher difficulty levels demand thoughtful strategies.

  • Progression and Achievements: Earn resources in battles, upgrade unit attributes, and unlock new abilities as you advance.

Whether you are looking for a casual RTS experience or a challenging battlefield to prove your tactical mastery, King of the Hill offers a rewarding journey through strategy and conquest.
